parameters:
Zahra-dono, there's a door that won't
open.
list._original: ザフラ殿、開かない扉があるぞ。

parameters:
Please rest assured. I have the
authority to open it.
list._original:
ご安心ください。
私は開く権限を持っています。

parameters:
So this isn't something we can leave to
Tadashi, huh?
list._original: ここは直任せじゃないんですね。

parameters:
Normally, a guide is required for a sun
viewing. Customers cannot participate on
their own.
list._original:
本来、太陽見学には案内が必要です。
お客様だけでは参加できません。

parameters:
Does "sun viewing" mean exactly what it
sounds like?
list._original: 太陽見学というのは文字通りの意味なのでしょうか。

parameters:
Yes. It's a light-attribute sphere
shining at the center of the inner
layer... It's an opportunity to approach
it.
list._original:
はい。
内層の中心で輝く光属性の球体……
それに近づいてみようというものです。

parameters:
I can't even begin to imagine how this
connects to freeing Amira-dono...
list._original:
アミーラ殿の解放にどう繋がるのか、
全く想像もつかないが……

parameters:
Now, let's go. You might feel a little
dizzy, so please be careful──
list._original:
さあ、行きましょう。
少し酔うかもしれませんので、ご注意を──

parameters.text:
Regarding the Project「Hero's Journey」(3)

　　　Based on historical events, an audience with the god under the attendant's guidance
　　　A challenge of the Hero's Trial (as a formality)
　　　Guests are guided from Aswad to each Burj (optional)
　　　If Burj conquest is desired, subjugation of the Sealer
　　　Showdown at Shamal Haram
　　　Presentation of commemorative items at the palace (and merchandise sales)

　　　That covers the rough outline of the flow.

parameters.text:
Proposed Revisions to the Project

　　　Iman:
　　　What about the curse cast upon the hero at the very end?
　　　This isn't a well-known story,
　　　but if we're basing this on historical events, I don't think it can be left out.

　　　Ruu:
　　　(To Iman) There's no need to reproduce that as well.
　　　It would ruin the sense of accomplishment.
　　　This is, after all, an experience meant to be enjoyed.

　　　Lloyd:
　　　Is Shamal Haram fine as the starting point?
